title: Bomb Pass power-up + classic-Bomberman bomb-block baseline
notes: Promotes GDP-2026-05-27-007 (could-priority, KABOOM-CREW-MVP-2). The GDP assumes 'bombs block bombers (with a placement grace tick)' as the baseline that Bomb Pass overrides. The pre-S152 engine actually let bombers walk freely through any bomb — no baseline. This sprint ships BOTH: the classic-Bomberman bomb-block baseline (own bomb is solid for the placer after they step off; others' bombs always solid) AND the Bomb Pass override for the placer's own bombs.

Implementation: a new project-local kaboom-bomb-block-system runs every frameUpdate AFTER player-input + bot-ai but BEFORE the engine's grid-movement-system (in registration order). It clears GridMover.queuedDirection when the would-be destination cell holds a blocking bomb (other's bomb, or own bomb post-step-off without bombPass). Grace is implicit: a bomb-cell-bound bomber moving to a NEIGHBOUR never has the bomb in the target cell. Mid-tween bombers (targetGx set) are skipped — the move was validated when it started.
Server parity (multiplayer connected mode) deferred — node-world-server's blast/placement pipeline is the next surface to mirror this; tracked as a follow-up.

stories.title: bomb-block-system — classic baseline + bombPass override
stories.summary: examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/bomb-block-system.ts (NEW). Project-local frameUpdate system that intercepts movement BEFORE grid-movement reads queuedDirection. Per bomber: if the would-be target cell holds a bomb that's (a) not the bomber's own → block, or (b) own bomb AND bomber.bombPass !== true → block. Blocking = setComponent(GridMover, queuedDirection={dx:0,dz:0}). Skips dead bombers + bombers mid-tween (targetGx set). Registered in both static + connected profiles after player-input + bot-ai.
verification: acceptance: bomb-block-system.ts (NEW) — per-frame intercept on GridMover.queuedDirection. Other's bomb at target → block. Own bomb post-step-off without bombPass → block. Own bomb post-step-off WITH bombPass → allowed. Walking AWAY from own bomb (target is neighbour) → no block (natural grace). Mid-tween + dead skipped. Registered in scheduler after player-input + bot-ai.
